Final steps:

4. Make sure /workspace/tmp doesn't have crash logs.

arguments.command:
cd /workspace && rm -rf tmp/classes && python3 build.py /workspace/submission/src /workspace/tmp/classes 2>&1|head -5 && python3 check.py /workspace/submission/src 2>&1|tail -2 && cd tmp/dev && for f in t1 t2 t3 t4 t5 t6 t7 t8 t9 t10 t11 t12 t13 t14 t15; do python3 $f.py > out/$f.txt 2>&1 || echo "FAIL $f"; done; grep -l "Traceback\|EXIT\|DIFF" out/*.txt; echo "targets ok"; ls /workspace/tmp; python3 -c "
import os,stat,pathlib
stack=[pathlib.Path('/workspace/tmp')];size=0;count=0
while stack:
    q=stack.pop(); count+=1
    s=q.lstat()
    if stat.S_ISREG(s.st_mode): size+=max(s.st_size,s.st_blocks*512)
    elif stat.S_ISDIR(s.st_mode):
        with os.scandir(q) as it: stack.extend(pathlib.Path(x.path) for x in it)
print('tmp bytes',size,'entries',count)
"
